title: spec: a slotted record page keeps six slots — header, actions, alerts, highlights, details, discussion — and the `tabs` slot is retired; a page that needs its own tab strip is a `kind: full` page
body:
Part of the record-page-v3 epic #26676 (v3 child 4 of 8). Contract card (spec lane); claimed from the epic session on the maintainer's instruction in the footer.

## Source (origin/main `7bb8084590`)

`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` `slots` (strict object, ~`:2121`) admits `header`, `actions`, `alerts`, `highlights`, `details`, `tabs`, `discussion` (aliases `activity` / `chatter` → `discussion`, `related` / `relatedLists` → `tabs`, `fields` / `body` → `details`); `checkPageSlotPair` (`:1262`, #22568) refuses `details` + `tabs` together. `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:~1130-1215` composes: a `tabs` slot replaces the whole synthesized strip (related / approvals / attachments / history included — the author must re-add them). With the column tiers (#26758) a `tabs` slot bypasses the tiers (`RecordDetailView.tsx:825` `pageColumnsEligible`): the page is tabbed at every width. HotCRM uses `slotted` once (account: `header` + `discussion`), never `tabs`.

## Target

1. `slots.tabs` is retired under the `spec-property-retirement` kit: tombstone via `retiredKey()` with the prescription 「the record page composes its tabs / columns from the object's roles and relationship flags; to change which related lists appear or their order, set `relatedList` / `relatedList: 'primary'` on the child's reference field; a page that needs its own strip is `kind: 'full'`」; the `related` / `relatedLists` aliases go with it; `checkPageSlotPair` and its test retire with the pair; ADR-0087 disposition (D2 conversion that drops the slot and, when it was the only slot, leaves an empty slotted page = the synthesized default; D3 entry for the judgement the edit cannot make — whether that page should become `kind: full`).
2. The synthesizer composes the strip / columns from the six remaining slots only; `RecordDetailView`'s `pageColumnsEligible` no longer needs the `tabs` branch.
3. Docs: `ui/content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md` slot menu, the generated references, the skill bullet (`skills/objectstack-ui/**` — governed, Tier H).

## File surface

`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` + the retirement kit files, spec tests; `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (one gate line), `ui/content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/*.md` (one bullet), changesets (`narrowed`, BREAKING with migration). Clause-②: no (narrowing); Metadata-protocol: narrowed.

## Acceptance

1. `safeParse` of `slots: { tabs: … }`, `related`, `relatedLists` fails with the prescription (`code` + `status` + first sentence); the six live slots parse; a stored slotted page with `tabs` replays through the conversion.
2. HotCRM account's slotted page still renders header + discussion overrides with the column tiers on.
3. Tree-scoped absence pin: nothing in the repo authors a `tabs` slot.

## Rulings (maintainer, chat in the filing session, 2026-10-28 — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. Record-page model (2026-10-27): 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the resident timeline column: 「时间线是不是太突出了，这个只适合部分对象吧？适合做所有业务对象的默认布局吗」 and then 「时间线是否显示，是否可以切换，比如当前版本的 Claude code，顶部有很多切换图标」 — the column's presence is a per-user toggle with an object-derived default, never metadata.
3. On the related column's cost: 「关联都放在右侧，记录打开时是不是会很慢，因为需要加载所有的关联子表。」 — the related column loads counts first, rows on demand, and never blocks the details.
4. On mobile: 「还要考虑手机端的效果。」
5. On the definition surfaces: the PM's keep / narrow / retire table was put to the maintainer (keep object roles, relationship flags, six slotted slots and `kind: full`; retire the `tabs` slot and the dead `BuildPageOptions` hints; fold the quick-look path into the one record page) and approved with the instruction in the footer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-28 under epic #26676 (record page v2 → v3), from the record-page definition-surface inventory on objectstack main `7bb8084590` and the maintainer's rulings in that session. The maintainer's instruction to file and dispatch, verbatim: 「同意，以上界面相关的需要我确认的你负责立卡派发，如果有可能可以启动云会话，开发完你来确认。」 Design evidence: the design canvas boards 「记录页 v3」 row (RecordPageV3, RecordPageV3NoTimeline, RecordPageRef, RecordDrawerV3, RecordMobile) — exported to the never-merged branch named in the epic parent once this batch is filed.</sub>
